title: Unit – 1 : Session – 2 : SLO – 2  |  Operating System as Resource Manager — Message Puzzle
sections: Choosing the letters for each cell of the puzzle rebuilds the paragraph:
"THE OPERATING SYSTEM ACTS AS A RESOURCE MANAGER. IT ALLOCATES THE CPU, MEMORY,
INPUT/OUTPUT DEVICES AND FILES AMONG COMPETING PROGRAMS, ENSURING EFFICIENT,
FAIR AND SECURE USE OF ALL HARDWARE RESOURCES."
II. Key Points of the Paragraph
The OS is the resource manager of the computer system.
Resources managed: CPU time, main memory, I/O devices, files and data.
Goals: efficient utilization, fairness among programs, protection and security.
